teaser: Four missed calls before noon, and you are the one calling back. Life path 33 asks for a kind of care that doesn't stop at your own door. Crossed with INTJ, the architect type, that care gets a blueprint. You don't only want to help; you want to build the structure that keeps helping once you've left the room. The warmth here is plain. So is the distance it sometimes needs, just to keep working.
